entities.summary: Lee Bul is a South Korean artist who works in various mediums, including performance, sculpture, installation, architecture, and media art. As curators such as Stephanie Rosenthal and art historians such as Yeon Shim Chung have observed, Lee Bul's artwork is shaped by both her social-political context and her personal experiences. Her works have engaged topics related to architecture, technology, gender, history, and memory. Lee lives and works in Seoul.
